title: coverage_snapshot
description: Coverage per sector for each catchment step. Precomputed by CoverageModel.

model_version_id.description: Coverage model that produced the row

children_covered.description: Children 0 to 6 with a place within the catchment

children_uncovered.description: Children 0 to 6 without a reachable place

catchment_minutes.description: Walking time used for the catchment

source.description: Named source, for example "NISR Census 2022" or "IrereroAI demo generator"

reference_year.description: Year the values describe, not the year they were loaded

origin.description: official | public | partner | simulated. Drives UI badges

pipeline_run_id.description: Pipeline run that loaded the row. Null for records entered through the app
